description: This file defines functions and constants for parsing, comparing, and managing release versions in an npm publishing context. It includes regex patterns for version formats, version parsing logic, comparison functions, and utilities for authentication handling and publishing decision logic.

methods.name: parseDateParts
methods.description: Parses date components and version info from regex groups for a given version and channel.

methods.name: parseReleaseVersion
methods.description: Parses a version string into a structured release version object.

methods.name: compareReleaseVersions
methods.description: Compares two release version strings, returning their order.

methods.name: resolveNpmPublishPlan
methods.description: Determines the npm publish plan based on version details and current beta version.

methods.name: resolveNpmDistTagMirrorAuth
methods.description: Determines authentication source for npm dist tag mirroring based on provided tokens.

methods.name: shouldRequireNpmDistTagMirrorAuth
methods.description: Decides whether authentication is required for publishing based on mode, tags, and existing auth.
